description:
In the Department of Spatial Design, there’s a rumor lately that has everyone curious.

Beom Chi-woo, known as a good-natured heartthrob, and Heo Geon-joo, who’s famous for being sociable, are at each other’s throats every time they make eye contact—so whose fault is this feud, anyway?

Nobody knows why this fight, which was sparked by Beom Chi-woo’s one-sided hatred, even started. Not even Heo Geon-joo, the guy right in the middle of it.

*Why? Seriously, for what reason? Did I do something wrong or what?*  
No matter how much he racks his brain, there’s no one around to give him a straight answer, leaving him fuming on his own for a whole month.

Beom Chi-woo has got to be crazy.  
At least, as far as Heo Geon-joo is concerned. *(Source: Bomtoon, translated)*

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/My_Nemesis)
